goal: nano-mcp: an MCP server + small SDK so any AI agent can hold XNO and pay per API call in Nano, through rpc.nano.to

laws.statement: Seed-based address derivation matches the official Nano example.
laws.test: tests verify seed->address derivation against official docs.nano.org examples: seed->priv (the-basics blake2b vector), priv->pub and pub->address (key-management key_expand example), plus address encoding against rpc.nano.to account_key ground truth and a live account_key round-trip of a derived SDK account.

laws.statement: Live balance/history reads work through rpc.nano.to without a local node.
laws.test: a test posts account_balance to NANO_RPC_URL for a known public account and asserts a numeric raw balance returns.

laws.statement: The ownership proof: the treasury receives the owner's 10 XNO (source block B42D35136339688A1E1AA8A5E07F5C95C15A7E806D2EE803D293B3BEE52010FB) with a single on-chain receive block whose confirmation is witnessed on two independent RPC endpoints.
laws.test: tests test the receive: run tools/receive_funding.py which (1) derives the treasury address == NANO_AGENT_ACCOUNT, (2) builds+signs an open/receive block (work root = account public key because frontier is all-zero), (3) broadcasts via rpc.nano.to process subtype=receive, (4) then account_info on two independent RPCs returns the new balance and the receive block appears in account_history. The receive only increases the balance (not an outgoing spend, outside the daily cap).

laws.statement: A real funded on-chain send from the treasury confirms and settles one paid mainnet call through nano-mcp exactly once, closing the standing L2 gap without faking.
laws.test: Buyer pays a nano-mcp paid tool on mainnet from the treasury; the send hash appears in account_history on two independent RPCs and the resource server settles exactly once.
